before: Carrot Defense-like is a single-level tower defense game. The player builds defensive towers on a fixed grid map to prevent enemies from following a predefined path and reaching the carrot target on the right side.
after: Carrot Defense-like is a single-level tower defense game. The player builds defensive towers on a fixed grid map to prevent enemies from following a predefined path and reaching the carrot target on the lower-right side.

before: Enemies enter from `(0,2)` and move through these cells in sequence until reaching the carrot near `(11,3)`.
after: Enemies enter from `(0,2)` and move through these cells in sequence until reaching the carrot near `(11,6)`.
The carrot endpoint at `(11,6)` should be visually positioned in the lower-right part of the grid.

before: The carrot is located near `(11,3)` and uses an orange body with green leaves.
after: The carrot is located near `(11,6)` and uses an orange body with green leaves.
The HP bar must remain fully visible inside or immediately adjacent to the map area despite the carrot's lower-right position.
The path starts at `(0,2)` and ends at `(11,6)`.

before: Enemies within a Wave spawn at fixed 0.8-second intervals.
after: Enemies within a Wave spawn at fixed 0.8-second intervals from entrance `(0,2)`.
The carrot returns to `(11,6)`, and enemies again use the fixed path from `(0,2)` to `(11,6)`.

before: Enemies spawn at path cell `(0,2)` and move through the fixed path toward `(11,3)`.
after: Enemies spawn at path cell `(0,2)` and move through the fixed path toward `(11,6)`.

before: Enemies in the current Wave spawn sequentially every 0.8 seconds.
after: Enemies in the current Wave spawn sequentially every 0.8 seconds from `(0,2)`.

before: If carrot HP reaches 0 or below, however, Failure occurs immediately and no subsequent wave-end settlement is processed.
after: If carrot HP reaches 0 or below, Failure occurs immediately and no subsequent wave-end settlement is processed.

before: At initialization, the game creates the interface areas, 12 × 8 map, fixed path, carrot, Gold resource, tower list, enemy list, Wave state, timers, and current selection.
after: At initialization, the game creates the interface areas, 12 × 8 map, fixed path from `(0,2)` to `(11,6)`, carrot at `(11,6)`, Gold resource, tower list, enemy list, Wave state, timers, and current selection.

before: Wave 1 begins with enemies spawning in its fixed order at 0.8-second intervals.
after: Wave 1 begins with enemies spawning from `(0,2)` in its fixed order at 0.8-second intervals.

before: When an enemy reaches the carrot, it is removed, damages the carrot, provides no Gold, and makes the current Wave ineligible for Perfect Wave.
after: When an enemy reaches the carrot at `(11,6)`, it is removed, damages the carrot, provides no Gold, and makes the current Wave ineligible for Perfect Wave.

before: The player's goal is to use Gold effectively across all 4 Waves, build and adjust defensive towers, prevent enemies from reaching the carrot, and keep carrot HP above 0.
after: The player's goal is to use Gold effectively across all 4 Waves, build and adjust defensive towers, prevent enemies from reaching the carrot at the lower-right endpoint, and keep carrot HP above 0.

before: R fully restores Gold, carrot HP, Waves, towers, enemies, timers, selection state, and all other gameplay state.
after: R fully restores Gold, carrot HP, Waves, towers, enemies, timers, selection state, carrot position, map-path state, and all other gameplay state.
